label: caiso 46 capdel probe
definition: (PROBE) capdel A/B vs keeper caiso-42: byte-faithful replay of the keeper meta.json + capacity_deliverability_limits=True as the single delta. Part A live: the calibrated 7,500 MW WECC_import simultaneous-import cap is replaced by the published branch-group MIC sum crosswalked to the WECC_import seam (16,055 / 16,452 / 16,148 MW for 2023/24/25). ATTRIBUTION vs the same-code flag-off baseline (caiso 47 capdel-arm-a): 2023-only effect — the old cap is a hard ceiling (binds 744 h, p95 = max = 7,500); released, imports peak 11.2 GW (+0.69 TWh), CAISO-zone mean LMP 65.16 -> 64.73, and the model's entire 107-hour >$200 tail collapses to 0 h (actual 21 h): the calibrated cap, not physics, generated the 2023 scarcity tail — right tail-hour count in the keeper era came from an over-tight fitted scalar (rule #1: not a real mechanism). 2024/25 strict price no-op (max |dLMP| = 0.0; import tranches bind at 4.3-6.1 GW before either cap). Neither representation matches 2023 actuals (107 h = 5.1x vs 0 h = 0x of 21 h): the published MIC sum is never approached (slack >= 4.9 GW every hour) because summed per-branch-group MICs overstate simultaneous capability (parallel WECC paths; rule #12 boundary caveat) — the true binding representation lies between the tranche build and the MIC arithmetic sum. Never a keeper; flag stays default-off.
